name: St. Regis Chicago
insider_take: Chicago's tallest residential tower doubles as an ultra-luxury hotel, where world-class service meets breathtaking skyline views in the heart of the Magnificent Mile.
whats_special: The St. Regis Chicago stands as the city's third-tallest building at 1,198 feet, featuring the iconic St. Regis Butler Service and a stunning 11th-floor terrace overlooking the Chicago River. The hotel occupies floors 12-27 of this architectural marvel designed by Studio Gang, offering unparalleled views of Lake Michigan and the city's famous skyline.
pro_tip: Book a Lake Michigan-facing room for sunrise views and request butler service to arrange private shopping experiences at the nearby luxury boutiques on Michigan Avenue.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to Millennium Park (just 3 blocks away) puts you steps from Cloud Gate and the Crown Fountain. Take advantage of the concierge's connections to secure reservations at Chicago's legendary steakhouses, and don't miss the building's unique "breathing" facade that subtly shifts throughout the day.
pros: Iconic skyscraper location in downtown Chicago with stunning city and lake views
Legendary St. Regis butler service and personalized attention
Ultra-modern luxury accommodations with contemporary design
Prime location near Magnificent Mile and major attractions
cons: Premium pricing typical of ultra-luxury downtown hotels
Newer property still establishing full service reputation
